articles.summary: Employees enterprise-wide complete AI literacy certification as the company promotes workforce readiness, responsible adoption and practical business applicationsWINDSOR, Conn., – Voya Financial, Inc. (NYSE: VOYA) today announced several key AI-driven initiatives advancing its customer service, claims processing, retirement operations and employee workflows, including millions of AI-enabled customer interactions.
articles.title: Voya advances strategic use of AI to enhance customer service, operations and employee productivity
